target.description: Position of the downstream tip of the visible flame along a thin fuel strip in concurrent flow, measured from the upstream (igniter) end of the sample, after the cutoff and conditional on the flow history up to each forecast time; with the probability that the flame has been quenched and that its tip has reached the end of the sample. The model works in sample widths; metres follow from the sample width of the prefix.
excludes: the flow history: the operator's steps are an input, known up to each forecast time
opposed-flow spread, thick fuels, materials other than the cotton-fibreglass fabric
a metric position without a sample width in metres from the data lane
temperature, heat flux, species or soot inferred from image intensity
a calibrated posterior: the spread is assumed

features.name: u
features.transform: U / norm.u_ref_cm_s - 1, U in cm/s, not below norm.u_min_cm_s @1

features.name: tip
features.transform: position / W; stills after the igniter is off and at or before the cutoff @1

tensors.name: speed.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the spread rate of the pyrolysis front, reference sample widths per second; row j reads (u, c_o2, c_w).

tensors.name: speed.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the spread rate of the pyrolysis front, reference sample widths per second (hinge positions).

tensors.name: speed.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the spread rate of the pyrolysis front, reference sample widths per second.

tensors.name: speed.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the spread rate of the pyrolysis front, reference sample widths per second in (u, c_o2, c_w); every element is stated.

tensors.name: speed.b0
tensors.description: Value of the spread rate of the pyrolysis front, reference sample widths per second at u = c_o2 = c_w = 0 before hinge terms.

tensors.name: over.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the steady overhang of the visible flame tip beyond the pyrolysis front, reference sample widths; row j reads (u, c_o2, c_w).

tensors.name: over.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the steady overhang of the visible flame tip beyond the pyrolysis front, reference sample widths (hinge positions).

tensors.name: over.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the steady overhang of the visible flame tip beyond the pyrolysis front, reference sample widths.

tensors.name: over.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the steady overhang of the visible flame tip beyond the pyrolysis front, reference sample widths in (u, c_o2, c_w); every element is stated.

tensors.name: over.b0
tensors.description: Value of the steady overhang of the visible flame tip beyond the pyrolysis front, reference sample widths at u = c_o2 = c_w = 0 before hinge terms.

tensors.name: burn.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the burn-through time ln(tau_b / 1 s): how long a place on the sample burns; row j reads (u, c_o2, c_w).

tensors.name: burn.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the burn-through time ln(tau_b / 1 s): how long a place on the sample burns (hinge positions).

tensors.name: burn.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the burn-through time ln(tau_b / 1 s): how long a place on the sample burns.

tensors.name: burn.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the burn-through time ln(tau_b / 1 s): how long a place on the sample burns in (u, c_o2, c_w); every element is stated.

tensors.name: burn.b0
tensors.description: Value of the burn-through time ln(tau_b / 1 s): how long a place on the sample burns at u = c_o2 = c_w = 0 before hinge terms.

tensors.name: quench.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the quench hazard ln(rate / 1 per s) of a flame at this flow and oxygen; row j reads (u, c_o2, c_w).

tensors.name: quench.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the quench hazard ln(rate / 1 per s) of a flame at this flow and oxygen (hinge positions).

tensors.name: quench.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the quench hazard ln(rate / 1 per s) of a flame at this flow and oxygen.

tensors.name: quench.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the quench hazard ln(rate / 1 per s) of a flame at this flow and oxygen in (u, c_o2, c_w); every element is stated.

tensors.name: quench.b0
tensors.description: Value of the quench hazard ln(rate / 1 per s) of a flame at this flow and oxygen at u = c_o2 = c_w = 0 before hinge terms.

tensors.name: speed.pow
tensors.description: Powers of (X_O2 / o2_ref) and of (W / W_ref) that multiply the spread rate in sample widths per second (a sample half as wide with the same speed in mm/s has the width power -1).

tensors.name: over.pow
tensors.description: Powers of (X_O2 / o2_ref) and of (W / W_ref) that multiply the overhang in sample widths.

tensors.name: over.tau_s
tensors.description: Time over which the overhang relaxes to its steady value after a change of flow.

tensors.name: ign.gain
tensors.description: Spread rate while the igniter is on, as a multiple of the law (the hot wire pilots the flame).

tensors.name: ign.delay_s
tensors.description: Time after the igniter is switched on before the front starts to move.

tensors.name: end.linger_s
tensors.description: Time the flame is still seen after its tip has reached the end of the sample.

tensors.name: enc.gain_w
tensors.description: Weights of the gain logit on ln(span / 10 s) and on the settled share min(1, seconds since the last change of flow / 10).

tensors.name: enc.gain_b
tensors.description: Bias of the gain logit: gain = sigmoid(gain_b + gain_w . inputs).

tensors.name: enc.mix
tensors.description: Weights of the tip-based and base-based offsets in the observed run offset (normalised over those available).

tensors.name: enc.e_clip
tensors.description: Largest run offset carried, below and above: E lies in [exp(-e_clip[0]), exp(e_clip[1])].

tensors.name: unc.s_pop
tensors.description: Relative sd of the spread rate of a run before its prefix says anything.

tensors.name: unc.s_floor
tensors.description: Relative sd of the spread rate that remains when the prefix is fully trusted.

tensors.name: unc.s_far
tensors.description: Relative sd added (in quadrature) per unit of |c_o2| and of |c_w|: the laws are known less well away from the reference oxygen and sample.

tensors.name: unc.sigma_w
tensors.description: sd of the tip position at the cutoff, sample widths (measurement and the still-to-overlay clock).

tensors.name: unc.sigma_x0_w
tensors.description: sd of the tip position when no still exists before the cutoff, sample widths.

tensors.name: unc.rel_over
tensors.description: sd of a change of the overhang, as a share of the modelled change.

tensors.name: unc.drift_w
tensors.description: Slow drift of the tip: sd in sample widths per square root of a second of lead.

tensors.name: speed.split
tensors.description: Share of the spread rate given by the split oxygen law, in which the part of the rate that remains at zero flow carries the oxygen power speed.pow_i and only the flow-dependent part carries speed.pow[0]: 1, the split law; between, the weighted mean of the split law and the law of the first front forward; 0: the law of the first front forward, one oxygen power for the whole rate.

tensors.name: speed.pow_i
tensors.description: Power of (X_O2 / o2_ref) that multiplies the zero-flow part of the spread rate (the rate the law gives with the fan stopped) in the split oxygen law; not read when speed.split is 0.

tensors.name: speed.kappa
tensors.description: Slow-down downstream, per sample width: the flow speed that the spread-rate law and the overhang target see falls by this share of itself for every sample width the front has advanced since the start of the forecast integration, U_eff = U max(0, 1 - kappa (x - x_ref)); 0: no slow-down.

tensors.name: over.tau_up_s
tensors.description: Time over which the overhang grows towards a larger steady value; over.tau_s is then the time over which it shrinks towards a smaller one; 0: over.tau_s in both directions.

tensors.name: unc.flow_abs_cm_s
tensors.description: Absolute uncertainty of the flow speed assigned to a fan setting: the lower and the higher flow path shift the flow history by this much.

tensors.name: unc.flow_rel
tensors.description: Relative uncertainty of the flow speed assigned to a fan setting: the lower and the higher flow path scale the flow history by 1 - flow_rel and 1 + flow_rel before the shift.

tensors.name: unc.flow_w
tensors.description: Weights of the three flow paths (lower, as read, higher), normalised by their sum; a path with weight zero is not run; [0, 1, 0], or no positive outer weight: one run on the flow as read.

tensors.name: norm.u_ref_cm_s
tensors.description: Reference flow speed of u.

tensors.name: norm.u_min_cm_s
tensors.description: Smallest flow speed the laws are evaluated at.

tensors.name: norm.o2_ref
tensors.description: Reference oxygen mole fraction of c_o2 and of the oxygen powers.

tensors.name: norm.o2_scale
tensors.description: Scale of c_o2.

tensors.name: norm.w_ref_m
tensors.description: Width of the reference sample (the 2 cm class), used only when a prefix gives a width in metres.

tensors.name: norm.v_min
tensors.description: Smallest spread rate, sample widths per second.

tensors.name: enc.end_s
tensors.description: Length of the first and of the last window of stills in the prefix.

tensors.name: enc.min_span_s
tensors.description: Shortest time between the two windows for a run offset to be read.

tensors.name: enc.change_cm_s
tensors.description: Smallest difference from the flow at the last window counted as a change of flow: the flow last changed at the start of the first entry after the most recent entry that differs from it by at least this much (a one-unit fan flicker is not a change, a slow ramp is one once it has moved this far).

tensors.name: num.dt_s
tensors.description: Integration step.

tensors.name: num.max_lead_s
tensors.description: Longest lead time after the cutoff.

tensors.name: oxygen.mix
tensors.description: Share of the steady oxygen-supply speed: 0 is exactly front2, 1 bypasses its speed network and powers. Overhang, prefix adjustment, burnout delay and event laws remain separate inherited closures.

tensors.name: oxygen.member_weight
tensors.description: Persistent oxygen-law scenario weight: 1 returns that scenario; 0 selects the predecessor speed law; intermediate values mix its full position CDF with the predecessor-speed scenario, never quantiles. When both this and oxygen.mix are positive, BOTH scenarios use the new coherent first-event closure. Thus joint event CDFs reinterpret the predecessor hazard and are not a mixture of its old event artifact rows. The corrected observation operator applies in every case.

tensors.name: oxygen.rho_kg_m3
tensors.description: Gas density at the authored reference state; no temperature or pressure adaptation is inferred.

tensors.name: oxygen.nu_m2_s
tensors.description: Kinematic viscosity in the capture-layer closure; author must disclose reference state and any use of hot-layer transport with ambient density.

tensors.name: oxygen.alpha_m2_s
tensors.description: Thermal diffusivity in the capture-layer closure, not an inferred oxygen molecular diffusivity.

tensors.name: oxygen.molar_o2_kg_mol
tensors.description: Molar mass of oxygen for converting input oxygen mole fraction to mass fraction.

tensors.name: oxygen.molar_carrier_kg_mol
tensors.description: Effective molar mass of the non-oxygen carrier; a fixed binary-mixture approximation.

tensors.name: oxygen.fuel_areal_kg_m2
tensors.description: TOTAL combustible fuel areal loading across the exposed faces; per-face loading equals this divided by oxygen.faces. Inert fiberglass mass is excluded.

tensors.name: oxygen.faces
tensors.description: Explicit effective exposed-face count in the oxygen budget. Each face supplies rho Y U delta; dividing total fuel loading by this gives the per-face balance.

tensors.name: oxygen.stoich_kg_o2_kg_fuel
tensors.description: Oxygen mass required per combustible fuel mass under the declared stoichiometric chemistry.

tensors.name: oxygen.residence_s
tensors.description: Authored steady flame residence time in L = v tau; independent of the inherited visible-base burnout delay.

tensors.name: oxygen.reference_width_m
tensors.description: Physical reference width for converting m/s into widths/s. For an active oxygen branch width_ratio is actual width divided by this reference, including in the inherited empirical laws. Set to norm.w_ref_m to preserve their width normalization.

notes: The oxygen branch uses Y = x M_O2 / (x M_O2 + (1-x) M_carrier), A = faces rho Y / (fuel_areal stoich), a = A^2 nu U residence, b = (A alpha)^2 and v = (a + sqrt(a^2 + 4b))/2 in m/s. U is actual nonnegative flow without the empirical flow floor. Divide by oxygen.reference_width_m times width_ratio. oxygen.mix=0 selects the front2 speed law; 1 bypasses its speed laws; intermediate values linearly blend speeds. The steady closure is not transient conservation, and its positive zero-flow branch does not assert flame survival. All properties and reference states are authored. oxygen.member_weight mixes persistent complete position CDFs across predecessor-speed and oxygen-speed scenarios. With oxygen.mix>0 and member_weight>0, BOTH scenarios use the new coherent first-event model: endpoint Gaussian exceedance envelope sampled at cutoff + k*num.dt_s is an assumed first-passage surrogate; finite end and quench exposures are competing constant hazards within each interval; end CDF=1 is a right-boundary atom after interval quenching. Initial end mass is assigned at cutoff. The event formulas later in this note describe the predecessor compatibility path only, retained exactly when either switch is zero; joint events reinterpret its hazard and are not an average of old artifact event rows. Physical scenarios require flow coverage back to igniter-on. Time is seconds after the igniter is switched off. The law path is integrated from the moment the igniter is switched on (front at the igniter, no overhang) with step num.dt_s: dx = g v dt with g = ign.gain while the igniter is on (after ign.delay_s) and 1 after; h relaxes exactly, h <- h_ss + (h - h_ss) exp(-dt / over.tau_s). Flow is a step function of time. Prefix windows: the stills of the first and of the last enc.end_s seconds of the prefix; window means of time, tip and base. Tip offset: ln of the advance of (tip - h) between the windows over the difference of mean law positions at those same still times; base offset: ln of the advance of the base over the difference of mean law positions at the base still times, each shifted back by tau_b at the later window. Offsets need enc.min_span_s between the windows and a positive law advance; a non-positive observed advance is taken as -enc.e_clip[0]. E = exp(clamp(gain x observed offset)), gain = sigmoid(enc.gain_b + enc.gain_w . (ln(span / 10 s), settled)), settled = clamp((t_e - t_change) / 10 s, 0, 1) at the last-window time t_e: with U_e the flow at t_e, t_change is the start time of the first flow entry after the most recent entry at or before t_e whose flow differs from U_e by at least enc.change_cm_s, and the time the igniter is switched on when no entry differs (never earlier than it). Position at the cutoff: last-window mean tip minus the mean modelled overhang at those still times, carried from the mean law position of the same window. Mean times set only the inherited gain and lead clocks, never the path averages. Spread of ln E: sqrt(gain s_floor^2 + (1 - gain) s_pop^2 + (s_far[0] c_o2)^2 + (s_far[1] c_w)^2). sd of the tip at lead: sqrt(sigma^2 + (s E advance)^2 + (rel_over x overhang change)^2 + drift_w^2 lead), Gaussian quantiles, cut at the end of the sample when its length is known. Quenched by t: 1 - exp(-integral of the quench hazard from the cutoff). Reached the end by t: the probability that the uncut tip was at or beyond the end at t - end.linger_s. Rows: active = (1 - quenched)(1 - reached), extinction = quenched, reached_end = (1 - quenched) reached. Additions of this forward, each off at the value its entry names. (A) speed.split > 0: with o = X_O2 / norm.o2_ref, N = max(N_speed(c), norm.v_min) and N0 the same with the flow feature at its value for U = 0 (norm.u_min_cm_s / norm.u_ref_cm_s - 1), v_split = max(N0 o^speed.pow_i + (N - N0) o^speed.pow[0], norm.v_min o^speed.pow_i) (W / W_ref)^speed.pow[1] and v = (1 - speed.split) v_first + speed.split v_split, v_first the rate above. (B) over.tau_up_s > 0: in an integration step that starts with h below h_ss the relaxation time is over.tau_up_s, otherwise over.tau_s (the exact relaxation never crosses h_ss inside a step). (C) speed.kappa > 0: t_ref is the cutoff, or 0 when no still is admitted; the law path is integrated without slow-down to the end of the step that contains t_ref, E is read, x_ref_law = law path at t_ref, and in every later step v and h_ss are evaluated at U max(0, 1 - speed.kappa E (X_i - x_ref_law)), X_i the law path at the start of the step; tau_b and the quench hazard keep U. (D) unc.flow_w[0] > 0 or unc.flow_w[2] > 0: for each k with unc.flow_w[k] > 0 the whole forward is run with the flow history U_k = max(0, U (1 + s_k unc.flow_rel) + s_k unc.flow_abs_cm_s), s = (-1, 0, 1), the prefix read again; weights unc.flow_w over their sum. Tip quantile at level p: the point where the weighted sum of the paths' Gaussian CDFs (uncut median and sd of each path) reaches p, by 60 halvings of the bracket [min(m_k - 9 sd_k), max(m_k + 9 sd_k)], then cut at the end of the sample; mean: weighted mean of the paths' means; base: weighted median of the paths' bases (linear between mass centres); quenched: weighted mean; reached the end: sum w (1 - q_k) e_k / sum w (1 - q_k) (the weighted mean of e_k when every path is quenched), so that each event row is the weighted mean of the paths' rows. Otherwise one run on the flow as read. Nothing is fitted at request time. Uncertainty kind: assumed_noise.
